About This Opportunity

We are seeking a detail-oriented, hands-on Payroll Accounting Manager to lead global payroll accounting. This individual will have a strong accounting background and experience in managing external payroll providers with full-cycle payroll – from communicating payroll changes and funding to reviewing payroll reports, preparing journal entries, and reconciling GL accounts. You will collaborate with external partners for global payroll and related compliance along with the internal people operations team, handle monthly close activities including journal entries. This role is ideal for an accounting professional who thrives in a fast-paced, international environment and wants to help scale finance operations in a high-growth AI company.

This is a temporary role with the potential to convert to  full-time employment.

What You Will Do
Global Payroll Accounting

  • Manage outsourced payroll providers across multiple geographies (e.g., US, APAC, EMEA)
  • Review weekly/monthly payrolls prepared by outsourced providers.
  • Ensure timely and accurate recording of payroll-related journal entries
  • Own reconciliation of payroll-related accounts (accrued payroll, bonuses, vacation, employer taxes), and support reconciliation of accrued commissions
  • Monitor compliance with local payroll tax regulations and labor laws with assistance of external payroll providers
  • Manage weekly/monthly payment process to both employees and the payroll providers and tax authorities.
  • Support 401k administration and 401k audit
  • Monitor and facilitate response to employee questions
  • Provide analysis on payroll-related costs
  • Support corporate and statutory audit requests as needed

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting
  • At least 7 years of experience with a focus in corporate accounting and related roles including international accounting and payroll accounting (including reviewing, approving, funding, preparing journal entries, preparing reconciliations)
  • At least 2 years of Big 4 public accounting experience is preferred or demonstrated solid accounting and internal control knowledge
  • Software and  SaaS industry experience preferred
  • Demonstrated in-depth knowledge of GAAP, month-end close processes, operational and international  accounting procedures both generally and as it relates to payroll accounting
  • Experience in an international multi-entity environment including managing outside service providers
  • Ability and willingness to meet business critical deadlines through time management and project management skillset
  • Advanced MS Excel skills and proficiency in all MS Office tools and G-Suite is a must
  • Demonstrated analytical skills, accuracy and attention to detail is a must
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and handle multiple tasks simultaneously 
  • Systems: NetSuite, SAP S/4Hana, Bill.com, ADP Workforce Now, Deel, GoGlobal

Why H2O.ai?

  • Market leader in total rewards
  • Remote-friendly culture
  • Flexible working environment
  • Be part of a world-class team
  • Career growth

H2O.ai is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status or any other legally protected basis.
